title: Des Moines Register, "In Armed Forces" enlistment list (2 November 1962)
citation: "In Armed Forces," Des Moines Register, Friday 2 November 1962, p. 23. Twenty-five enlistments reported by the Des Moines recruiting stations; the ARMY list includes Ronald E. Totosz, 21, of Des Moines. newspapers.com image 129134885; permanent clipping 203981003.
notes: The only item in print found anywhere that records Ron Totosz’s military service, and the anchor of the identification. A standard three-year Regular Army enlistment from November 1962 runs to November 1965, bracketing Larry’s tour and matching his own separation on 30 November 1965. It establishes Army service, age and city. It does NOT place Ron in Vietnam or in Larry’s unit, and no document yet does, which is why the identification is strongly supported rather than confirmed.
